b1-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why My Own Bag
b1-16-01.scenario: Petra sees Meg's own shopping bag at the office and asks why she uses it. You (Meg) say that there is a lot of plastic waste, so you use your own bag, and that we all have to do a lot for environmental protection.
b1-16-01.prompt: Tell Petra why you use your own bag and what we have to do.
cues: Say that there is a lot of plastic waste and what follows from it
Say that we have to do a lot for environmental protection
b1-16-01.target: Sok a műanyaghulladék, ezért saját szatyrot használok. Sokat kell tennünk a környezetvédelemért.
b1-16-01.english: There is a lot of plastic waste, so I use my own bag. We have to do a lot for environmental protection.
b1-16-01.canDo: I can say why something happens with mert and what follows with ezért.

b1-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: More Storms
b1-16-02.scenario: Károly reads that the weather is changing and asks Meg why there are so many storms this summer. You (Meg) say that because of climate change there are more storms, as a result of which there is a lot of trouble, and that because of this we have to take care of nature.
b1-16-02.prompt: Tell Károly why there are more storms and what follows from it.
cues: Say what causes the storms and what comes of it
Say what we have to do because of this
b1-16-02.target: A klímaváltozás miatt több a vihar, aminek következtében sok a baj. Emiatt vigyáznunk kell a természetre.
b1-16-02.english: Because of climate change there are more storms, as a result of which there is a lot of trouble. Because of this we have to take care of nature.
b1-16-02.canDo: I can say that one thing leads to another with emiatt and aminek következtében.

b1-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: If the Water Is Dirty
b1-16-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she thinks will happen to a small river near the city if nobody takes care of it. You (Meg) say that if the water is dirty the fish are ill, and that because of deforestation the forest disappears.
b1-16-03.prompt: Tell Anna what happens to the fish and to the forest.
cues: Say what happens to the fish if the water is dirty
Say what happens to the forest because of deforestation
b1-16-03.target: Ha piszkos a víz, a halak betegek. Az erdőirtás miatt eltűnik az erdő.
b1-16-03.english: If the water is dirty, the fish are ill. Because of deforestation the forest disappears.
b1-16-03.canDo: I can say what happens if we do or do not take care of nature, using ha.

b1-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why We Recycle
b1-16-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg why people recycle. You (Meg) say that recycling is important for nature, and that we recycle so that nature stays clean.
b1-16-04.prompt: Tell Károly why recycling matters and what we recycle for.
cues: Say that recycling is important for nature
b1-16-04.target: Az újrahasznosítás fontos a természetnek. Azért újrahasznosítunk, hogy tiszta maradjon a természet.
b1-16-04.english: Recycling is important for nature. We recycle so that nature stays clean.
b1-16-04.canDo: I can turn a verb into a noun with -ás or -és, like újrahasznosítás.

b1-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Usually Do
b1-16-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she usually does for the environment. You (Meg) say that you usually buy from local producers, and that in your opinion waste reduction is important.
b1-16-05.prompt: Tell Petra where you usually buy things and what you think is important.
cues: Say what you think is important
b1-16-05.target: Helyi termelőktől szoktam vásárolni. Véleményem szerint a hulladékcsökkentés fontos.
b1-16-05.english: I usually buy from local producers. In my opinion waste reduction is important.
b1-16-05.canDo: I can say what I usually do for nature with szokott + infinitive.

b1-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Walk in the Park
b1-16-consolidation.scenario: Anna and Meg are walking in the park, and Anna asks Meg what she does for the environment. You (Meg) say that you recycle because there is a lot of plastic waste, and that we have to take care of the water so that it stays clean.
b1-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna what you do and why, and what we have to take care of.
cues: Say what you do and why
Say what we have to take care of and what for
b1-16-consolidation.target: Újrahasznosítok, mert sok a műanyaghulladék. Vigyáznunk kell a vízre, hogy tiszta maradjon.
b1-16-consolidation.english: I recycle because there is a lot of plastic waste. We have to take care of the water so that it stays clean.
b1-16-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the environment: why things happen, what we have to do and what I do myself.
